content: Asnuqqeb n Dina zi Cakim, mmis n Ḥamur
Dina, yeǧis n Liya, tenni dd-turuw i Yaɛqub, teffeɣ, ḥima ad temmeřqa ak-d yessis n temmurt.
Cakim, mmis n Ḥamur Aḥiwi, řḥakem n temmurt nni, iẓra i-tt, iksi tt uca iṭṭeṣ akides, issexsar i-tt.
Iṭṭarbeṭ di Dina, yeǧis n Yaɛqub, u netta ixs tabřiɣt uca issiweř ɣar wuř n tebřiɣt.
Issiweř Cakim ɣar Ḥamur babas, inna as: “Awyi ayi-dd tabřiɣt-a d tamɣart.”
Řami isřa Yaɛqub belli Cakim iḍeyyeɛ ccaraf n yeǧis Dina, tuɣa iḥenjiren nnes ak-d řebhayem deg iyyar. Issusem Yaɛqub ařami dd-ɛeqben nitni.
Iruḥ Ḥamur, babas n Cakim ɣar Yaɛqub, ḥima ad kis issiweř.
Tarwa n Yaɛqub dewřen-dd zeg iyyar uca areggben x řexbar. Xeyyqen x man aya deg wuř u ffugmen aṭṭas, minzi igga řefḍiḥet-a di Israil umi iṭṭeṣ ak-d yeǧis n Yaɛqub. man aya war icuwwar ad t yegg.
Issiweř Ḥamur akidsen, inna: “Řeɛmar n mmi Cakim iqqen ɣar yeǧitwem, ttzawageɣ, ad as tt tewcem d tamɣart,
uca ad nemḍeggwař. Ad aneɣ tewcem yeǧitwem, kenniw ad teksim yessitneɣ i yixef nwem.
Zedɣem akidneɣ, minzi tammurt aqa-tt zzatwem. Zedɣem u uyurem dayes uca ṭṭfem dayes agřa i kenniw.”
Uca inna Cakim ɛawed i babas d aytmas: “Ejj ayi ad afeɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nwem uca ad wceɣ min d ayi ɣa tinim.
Waxxa ad tessḍeqřem xafi řeḥmeř aṭṭas n ṣṣadaq d ssunan, aqa necc ad wceɣ mecḥař ma d ayi ɣa tinim. Wcem ayi mɣir tabřiɣt d tamɣart.”
Arrin-dd iḥenjiren n Yaɛqub x Cakim d Ḥamur, babas, s ict n teḥraymect, minzi aqa issexsar Dina, učmatsen.
Nitni ssiwřen, nnan asen: “War nzemmar ad negg ammu, ad newc učmatneɣ i weryaz nni ɛad s řeɛdařyet. Degga d řɛar xaneɣ.
Mɣir s umtawi-ya waha ad kenniw nseɛɛef, mařa teggim am neccin, ad tᵉttwaxetnem marra iwetman nwem.
Xenni ad awem newc yeǧitneɣ uca ad neksi yessitwem, ad kidwen nezdeɣ, ad niři d ijj n řgens.
Maca mařa war d aneɣ tesřim di tmesřact n wextan, xenni ad neksi yeǧitneɣ uca ad nuyur.”
Banen wawařen nsen mliḥ deg imezzuɣen n Ḥamur u deg imejjan n Cakim, mmis n Ḥamur.
Aɛezri war d as icqi ad igg man aya, minzi netta ittexs aṭṭas yeǧis n Yaɛqub u netta tuɣa-t qaɛ mweqqar di marra taddart n babas.
Uca usin-dd Ḥamur d mmis Cakim ɣar tewwart n tendint nnes, ssiwřen ak-d yeryazen n tendint, nnan:

“Iryazen-a d imhudnen akidneɣ. Ejj aneɣ ad ten nejj ad zedɣen di temmurt-a uca ad dayes uyuren. Xzar, tammurt tewseɛ i nitni ɣar marra iɣezdisen nnes. Neccin ad neksi yessitsen d timɣarin, ad asen newc yessitneɣ.
Maca s umtawi-ya waha ad seɛɛfen yeryazen-a, ḥima ad kidneɣ zedɣen u ḥima ad dewřen d ijj n řgens akidneɣ, mařa marra iryazen i iǧan jar aneɣ ad ttwaxetnen am mammec ttwaxetnen nitni.
Řebhayem nsen d agřa nsen d marra řmař nsen, ma war ttiřin nneɣ? Ejj aneɣ ad ten nseɛɛef, xenni ad zedɣen akidneɣ.”
Marra inni dd-yusin ɣar tewwart n tendint nnes sřin i Ḥamur d mmis Cakim uca marra iryazen inni dd-yusin ɣar tewwart n tendint nnes, ttwaxetnen.

Umi tuɣa ɛad daysen řehriq deg wass wiss třata, temsar belli iḥenjiren n Yaɛqub, Cimɛun d Lawi, aytmas n Dina, aqa kuř ijj zzaysen iksi ssif nnes uca ruḥen ɣar tendint mani d asen ittɣiř aqa dayes řaman uca nɣin marra iryazen.
Nɣin Ḥamur d mmis Cakim s řeqḍeɛ n ssif uca ksin Dina zi taddart n Cakim, ffɣen.
Tarwa n Yaɛqub usin-dd ɣar yinni ittwanɣen uca keccḍen tandint, minzi nitni ssexsaren učmatsen.
Ksin uǧi nsen d ifunasen d tfunasin nsen d yeɣyař nsen d marra min tuɣa di tendint u deg iyyar.
Ksin marra agřa nnes uca iwyen-dd marra iḥenjiren d temɣarin nsen d imeḥbas uca ucaren marra min tuɣa di tudrin.

Xenni inna Yaɛqub i Cimɛun d Lawi: “Kenniw tessidfem ayi deg imxumbar ařami d ayi tessarzgem ɣar imezdaɣ n temmurt-a, ɣar ayt n Kenɛan d Ifiriziyyen. D necc ɣari ijj n wuru n yeryazen waha. Mařa ad munen x uzeřmaḍ inu, ad ayi qeẓẓren, ad iřiɣ areyyteɣ, necc d taddart inu.”
Nitni nnan: “Ma iɛeddeř xenni ad iḥseb učmatneɣ amecnaw ict n lfasda?”
